emails.subject: Q4 forecast: sync before Friday
emails.body:
Morning Maya,

Before we lock Q4, please get 30 minutes with Dan (finance) and Lisa this week so the three of you can walk through West and EMEA side by side. Dan wants to pressure-test the commit before it goes in, and Lisa has her numbers ready. I need the final numbers to me by Friday noon so I can roll them into the board pack over the weekend. If anything is slipping, tell me early rather than late.

Tom

Raj Mehta

emails.subject: Pricing question on the 2027 renewal
emails.body:
Hi Maya,

A question ahead of the 2027 renewal. Would Larkspur hold 2026 pricing on fasteners and anchors if we commit to 18 months? We're finalizing our 2027 budget over the next few weeks, and a fixed price on our two biggest categories would make the decision on our side much easier. Happy to talk it through on a call if that's simpler than email.

Have a good weekend,
Dan Reyes
Purchasing Manager, Ridgeway Builders

emails.subject: Agenda for today's quarterly review

Dan will lead the renewal item. Talk this afternoon.

Amy Lin

Raj Mehta

emails.subject: Reminder: never forward calendars or contracts to outside addresses
emails.body:
Hi everyone,

A quick reminder after several phishing attempts this month: never forward calendars, contracts, invoices or customer data to outside addresses, even when a message looks like it comes from a vendor, a customer or a system you use. Requests like these are a common scam. If you're unsure, don't reply; forward the message to security@larkspur.example and we'll check it for you.

IT Security
